find.title: How to find or register a patient

steps.1: Type the mobile or the patient number.
steps.2: Found? Tap the name. If not, tap "New patient".
steps.3: Name, age or date of birth, sex and mobile are enough; add the rest later.
steps.4: Print the card (QR) for the patient to bring next time.

tips.1: Mobile numbers work in any form, Bangla digits too.

mistakes.1: A warning shows when the mobile already exists: check before adding a second record.

find.settings: Patient number prefix, the ID number rule and the duplicate check are in the Patients settings.

history.title: How to read a patient's history

steps.2: See every visit, report, prescription and bill by date.

tips.1: Opening this page is recorded, for the patient's privacy.
tips.2: Allergies show in red at the top.

mistakes.1: Two records for one person? Use "Merge into another" instead of making changes on both.

steps.2: Check both records are the same person.
steps.3: Approve, or reject with a note.

tips.1: You cannot approve your own request.
